title: Script checker test (every banned pattern)
_about: Each section breaks one rule from reference/voice-rules.md on purpose (expect = the error the checker must raise); the ok- sections follow the rules and must raise no error. Used by scripts/script/test_check.py.

sections.name: cheerful-easy
sections.talk: [relaxed] Okay, so you hit Save up top on the form. Easy. And the next page opens.
sections.caption: Click the button to continue.

sections.name: cheerful-there-we-go

sections.caption: Click the button to continue.

sections.caption: Click the button to continue.

sections.name: crowded
sections.talk: [relaxed] The form has Details, Pricing, Apps, Settings and Generate, all in one long column you scroll through.
sections.caption: The form has Details, Pricing, Apps, Settings and Generate.

sections.name: ok-spread-out
sections.talk: [relaxed] Details is the first block on the form. Under it there's Pricing, which is where the money side lives, and further down you get Apps, for whatever comes with it.
sections.caption: Details comes first, then Pricing, then Apps.
